caption: The video captures a tight close-up of a drum kit in a warmly lit room, with a large, slightly out-of-focus cymbal dominating the left foreground. A wood-finish tom sits at center-right while a snare, hi-hat and angled cymbal fill the frame. Behind the kit a seated drummer in a grey long-sleeve top and dark trousers holds two drumsticks, their hands partly hidden by the cymbal. Throughout, the hands and sticks move in a fast, rhythmic up-and-down pattern, blurring at several moments. The sticks alternate between a near-vertical orientation pointing toward the tom and a more horizontal orientation, while the hands periodically drop behind the cymbal and reappear. The drummer's torso and arms shift slightly with the playing motion, and the foreground cymbal shows small tilt changes, suggesting it is vibrating. The drum shells, hardware, stands, a wooden background surface and a blue cloth stay in place, and the camera framing remains largely steady, so the visible motion is the ongoing playing.
